name: Neratovice (Czechia)
description: A red vertical stripe at the hoist one third of the flag's length, and two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over blue in the fly.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 30 March 1977 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
